propositions: Gate runs do not warn when the running build's commit is a strict ancestor of the pinned base ref, allowing stale code to silently review against current configurations
A checkout behind origin/main uses old build code to read current config keys it does not recognize, producing misleading 'typo' warnings instead of indicating build drift
The drift detection must be idempotent per (build_sha, pinned_sha) pair and must not fail runs or alter verdicts, signatures, or provenance
When build provenance is unavailable or the build sha does not exist in the target repo, the gate must remain silent rather than warn
Config unknown-key warnings must distinguish between typos and drift-related unrecognized keys by rewording the message when drift is detected
